purpose: Independent four-wheel measured data; geometry and slip reference provenance retained for BWR comparison

source.title: Experimental Evaluation of Rover Mobility Prediction Methods using Single Wheel Experiments
source.author: Alexander Demishkevich
source.geometry_location: Figure 3.5 and section 3.2, printed pages 29-30, PDF pages 41-42; Table 4.2, printed page 46
source.slip_location: Table 4.8, Full Rover Results row, printed page 51, PDF page 63

rover.platform: Four-wheel Clearpath Husky with scaled rigid grouser wheels
rover.soil: GRC-1 lunar simulant, prepared at approximately 28-31 percent relative density
rover.environment: Earth tilt-bed experiments; dimensions/mass selected using the source's granular scaling law procedure

measurement.type: Numerical transcription from the Full Rover Results row, not the single-wheel prediction rows
measurement.method: Rover position measured by Leica Total Station, compared with commanded wheel motion; steady-state average slip
measurement.repeat_information: Section 4.4.3 describes averaging two full-rover slope trials for the validation comparison

comparison_limit: 384 mm outer diameter exceeds the present table maximum of 327 mm. The strict model rejects this geometry; no extrapolated prediction is supplied.
